default.customLoveLetter:
My Dearest Love,

If I had to live my life all over again, I would find you sooner so that I could love you longer.

From the moment you entered my world, everything changed. Colors became brighter, music sounded sweeter, and every quiet dream I held found its destination in your smile.

Thank you for being my anchor when storms rise, my laughter when joy is shared, and my favorite thought at the end of every long day. No matter where the winds of tomorrow take us, my heart will forever beat in harmony with yours.

Forever and always,
Yours completely 💗
